notes.title: Major update! with a variety of innovative functions. Completely new graphics!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37209351/b93a49a8799da71ae220b28e71e757b58fc46ede.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37209351/9109b2d6901d148ebdd078066dcb6320e54bd882.jpg[/img]

[h2]With the help of the free spins on the wheel of fortune and the easy mode, you can now reach your goal faster!
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37209351/fad2df13944f8a121dfb6876288ba947b72eed0e.jpg[/img]
